source_snapshot.items: NVQual - PCIE AER Error Check Test
source_snapshot.procedure: Check PCIe AER errors for all attached endpoints after clearing logs.
source_snapshot.criteria: Information readable/no spelling error; FW Version correct.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; proprietary readout without coverage or preservation policy.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: RPUC/CHANGED; preserve existing evidence, verify endpoint coverage and firmware reference.

historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Rejects destructive log clearing and adds topology/counter semantics.
historical_reviews.related_cases: Fault injection and link-stress are separate from passive AER checking.

original_test_intent: Inspect every attached PCIe endpoint and upstream path for pre-existing or test-window AER errors and compare severity/count against the approved zero/delta policy.
original_method: Pin read-only NVQual module/config; map endpoint serial/BDF through bridges/root ports; preserve pre-test dmesg/journal/SEL and AER counters instead of clearing; capture baseline and post window; normalize correctable/nonfatal/fatal fields; retain unsupported/missing paths and compare approved deltas.
manual_activity: PCIe owner supplies endpoint topology, firmware reference and accepted AER baseline/delta policy; agent can perform read-only collection.
required_inputs: Signed NVQual AER artifact/config and read-only proof
Correctable/nonfatal/fatal counter sources and baseline/delta rule
Expected firmware manifest and observation window
safety_requirements: Never clear diagnostic logs or counters
No fault injection or link mutation
Preserve existing and new errors separately
agent_execution_scope: Collect baseline/post AER and logs read-only
engineer_actions: Resolve existing errors or missing coverage

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: A generic vendor readout may help but lacks topology, counter schema and evidence preservation.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Run only the reviewed read-only AER module and corroborate with preserved OS/PCIe/BMC counters per mapped path.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: All attached endpoints remain in scope; log clearing is rejected as unsafe evidence destruction.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Build a per-path baseline/post table for each AER severity and source.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Preserves evidence and defines complete topology coverage.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Firmware/readability alone cannot establish AER health.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Counters can be cumulative and ownership differs across root port, switch and endpoint.

project_override_considerations: Project policy determines whether any correctable baseline is acceptable and the observation window for zero-new-error checks.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure asks for all-endpoint AER checking while Criteria only mention text and firmware; source also directs destructive log clearing.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Read-only collection is provisionable once artifact/topology/policy inputs exist.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Compatibility row314 Wistron-NV GPU-00307-V003: approve the read-only NVQual AER module, endpoint/path coverage, severity/counter sources and baseline-versus-delta acceptance, preserve rather than clear logs, and map or replace unrelated readability/FW Criteria.

review_improvement: Converts the AER check into a complete per-path delta audit without erasing prior diagnostic evidence.
independent_technical_reasoning: AER may be logged at an upstream port rather than the endpoint, and counters are often cumulative. Complete topology correlation plus a preserved baseline is therefore necessary to attribute new correctable, nonfatal or fatal errors correctly.
